messages:
Maya R: Standup — quick GPU fleet availability / headroom check
what I did: ran headroom calc across regions (us-west1 / us-east1 / eu-west1), validated node health, spot eviction stats. Found ~9% headroom on us-west1, ~16% on us-east1, ~3% on eu-west1.
blockers: quota increase request for eu-west1 still pending (cloud req Q-4832). Also seeing AZ imbalance in eu-west1-a where allocation fails with `InsufficientCapacity`.
today: escalate quota request, prepare targeted burst plan (move non-prod batch to us-east1), open PR to lower autoscaler scale-down aggressiveness for next 24h.

Jon P: Thanks Maya. I pinged the account rep this morning — they acknowledged but need internal approval. Putting the cloud ticket link in the ticket: https://internal-ticketing.company/Q-4832
I can also try a soft-alloc workaround: spin an extra nodepool with different machine type tonight.

Sasha K: Noted on AZ imbalance. I reproduced the `InsufficientCapacity` on a couple of allocations — looks like scheduler prioritizes regional affinity without fallback. Filed infra issue #345 to add AZ fallback logic. Repro:
```
kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep gpu
# then attempt provisioning with the same constraints as the failing job
```
I also saw the autoscaler not draining preemptible nodes during rapid reclaim — might be related to the scale-down timing.

Liam T: Can we move some dev/qa batch queues to eu-central? We had spare quota there last week. If so I can run the migration script after 19:00 UTC.

infra-bot: nightly-provisioner: completed run at 02:12 UTC — +12 GPUs in us-east1 (added to pool `gpu-batch-ephemeral`). No failures.

Maya R: Plan update: if Q-4832 not approved by 17:00 UTC I'll trigger the targeted burst to us-east1 and enable the AZ fallback branch from #345 in staging. I'll also reduce batch concurrency for low-priority jobs to free ~20 GPUs. Posting escalation note in the cloud workspace and looping in Sales for customer-impact heads-up.

Jon P: I'll drop the nodepool CR and tag on-call if quota still pending at 16:00 UTC.

Sasha K: Added a short runbook to the issue for manual fallback (commands + what to watch). :thumbsup:

Liam T: I can start the eu-central prep at 19:00 and will post results here.

Maya R: Awesome — ping me if you see `InsufficientCapacity` spikes. I'll follow up after I hear back from the account rep.
